spells.description: The Opening Charm | Opens objects
spells.notable_uses: Queenie Goldstein tries to open Percival Graves's office after Alohomora fails

spells.description: The Summoning Charm | Summons desired objects (either in or out of eyesight) to the spellcaster
spells.notable_uses: Harry summons his Firebolt from the castle during the First Task of the Triwizard Tournament

spells.description: The Water-Conjuring Charm | Conjures clean, drinkable water from the end of the wand
spells.notable_uses: Hermione extinguishes Mundungus Fletcher’s eyebrows after Harry accidentally ignites them with red sparks

spells.description: The Unlocking Charm | Unlocks objects
spells.notable_uses: Hermione unlocks the door to the forbidden 3rd floor corridor to hide from Argus Filch

spells.description: The Tracking Spell | Illuminates recent tracks of magical activity in the area
spells.notable_uses: Newt Scamander uses this to investigate what happened to Tina in Place Cachée

spells.description: The Spider-Banishing Charm | A non-explosive spell used for blasting spiders away
spells.notable_uses: Used by Harry to blast Acromantulas out of the way

spells.description: The Ascension Charm | Lifts the target high into the air
spells.notable_uses: Used by Harry in the Triwizard Tournament after being attacked by Grindylows

spells.description: The Bombardment Spell | Creates small explosions or blasts
spells.notable_uses: Used by Hermione to liberate Sirius Black

spells.description: The Limb-Binding Jinx | Used to bind an opponent
spells.notable_uses: Harry uses this jinx on Draco in their duel in Harry's kitchen

spells.description: The Singing Charm | Bewitches the target to sing
spells.notable_uses: At Christmas, the suits of armour had all been bewitched to sing carols whenever anyone passed them

spells.description: The Locking Charm | Locks and seals objects
spells.notable_uses: Harry, Hermione, Neville and Luna seal the doors behind them as they’re being chased through the Department of Mysteries

spells.description: The Stickfast Jinx | Sticks the target’s shoes to the ground
The Colour-Changing Charm | Changes the colour of the target
spells.notable_uses: In the Charms O.W.L. exam, fifth-years are required to turn a rat orange

spells.description: The Blasting Curse | Causes an explosion at the target
spells.notable_uses: Harry causes the sidecar of Sirius Black’s flying motorbike to explode, blasting a pursuing Death Eater off his broom

spells.description: The Confundus Charm | Causes the target to be confused or bewitches a sentient being
spells.notable_uses: Hermione confounds Cormac McLaggen to miss a goal during Quidditch Trials

spells.description: The Banishing Charm | Forces the target away from the caster
spells.notable_uses: While learning the charm, Neville accidentally sends Professor Flitwick flying across the room

spells.description: The Descending Charm | Causes the target to move downwards
spells.notable_uses: Ron lowers the ladder to the Burrow’s attic

spells.description: The Vanishing Spell | Makes the contents of the target vanish (easier than Conjuring Spells)
spells.notable_uses: Snape vanishes the contents of Harry's cauldron during an unsuccessful Potions lesson

spells.description: The Fly-Back Jinx | Causes the opponent to fly back several feet
spells.notable_uses: Draco used this jinx against Harry in the Duelling Club

spells.description: The Patronus Charm | Conjures, through the power of a very happy memory, a positive force that acts as a protective magical guardian
spells.notable_uses: Harry casts his stag Patronus to rescue himself, Hermione & Sirius from Dementors by the Black Lake

spells.description: The Disarming Charm | Removes an object from the target's grasp
spells.notable_uses: Harry’s signature move, he teaches Dumbledore’s Army how to disarm at their first meeting

spells.description: The Expulsion Spell | Blows up the target
spells.notable_uses: A Death Eater blows up a table and the force of the explosion throws Harry into a wall

spells.description: The Shattering Spell | Shatters glass into dust
spells.notable_uses: Newt Scamander shatters a glass window at a jewellery store to get to his niffler

spells.description: The General Counter-Spell | Terminates most spell effects
spells.notable_uses: Snape lifts the Dancing Feet Spell Draco casts on Harry during the Duelling Club

spells.description: The Drawing Spell | Causes a fiery red trail to be produced by the caster’s wand which can be used to temporarily mark objects or draw shapes in mid-air
spells.notable_uses: Hermione draws a fiery ‘X’ to mark the doors in the Department of Mysteries that they have already tried

spells.description: The Knockback Jinx | Sends the target twirling through the air
spells.notable_uses: Harry is sent twirling through the air by Draco during their duel in the Potters’ kitchen

spells.description: The Cuff Jinx | Binds opponent’s hands in luminous cords
spells.notable_uses: Delphi binds Scorpius and Albus Severus' hands as they discover her dark secret

spells.description: The Ice Jinx | Fires an icing blast from a wand, freezing the target in ice
The Gardening Charm | Rapidly increases the growth rate of plants and causes flowers to bloom
The Freezing Charm | Immobilises the target
spells.notable_uses: Hermione immobilises two of the pixies released by Professor Lockhart and stuffs them back into their cage

spells.description: The Impediment Jinx | Freezes an attacker for a few moments or stops a magical beast in its tracks
spells.notable_uses: Harry freezes an enormous Blast-Ended Skrewt during the third task of the Triwizard Tournament

spells.description: The Binding Jinx | Wraps the target tightly in ropes
spells.notable_uses: Umbridge ties up the centaur Magorian in the Forbidden Forest

spells.description: The Fire-Making Spell | Conjures flames
spells.notable_uses: Mr. Weasley conjures flames in the Dursleys’ fireplace

spells.description: The Tongue-Sticking Hex | Glues the targets tongue to the roof of their mouth
spells.notable_uses: Harry uses it to silence Peeves

spells.description: The Locomotion Charm | Lifts the target a few inches off of the ground and allows the caster to move the object in any given direction
spells.notable_uses: Tonks uses the spell to lift Harry’s trunk. Her wand is kept pointed at the object like a conductor’s baton as she makes it hover out of Harry’s room and down the stairs

spells.description: The Wand-Lighting Charm | Illuminates the tip of the caster's wand
spells.notable_uses: Harry lights his wand when he thinks he’s being watched in Magnolia Crescent and accidentally hails the Knight Bus

spells.description: The Wand-Lighting Charm | Illuminates the tip of the caster's wand even brighter
spells.notable_uses: Harry lights his wand when he thinks he’s being watched in Magnolia Crescent and accidentally hails the Knight Bus

spells.description: The Weather-Modifying Charm | Creates contained weather patterns indoors or out – like a storm cloud or snow
spells.notable_uses: Mr. Weasley mentions that "a lot of offices have been raining lately" within the Ministry of Magic

spells.description: The Wand Light Counter-Charm | Causes the light at the end of the caster's wand to be extinguished (counter-charm to Lumos)
spells.notable_uses: Harry and Hermione extinguish their wands before encountering Sirius in the Shrieking Shack

spells.description: The Bouquet Spell | Conjures a bouquet of flowers from the tip of the caster’s wand
spells.notable_uses: Mr. Ollivander uses the spell to test the functionality of Fleur Delacour’s wand during the Wand Weighing ceremony ahead of the Triwizard Tournament

spells.description: The Fiendfyre Curse | Conjures uncontrollable, cursed flames of abnormal size that cannot be extinguished
spells.notable_uses:
Conjured by Vincent Crabbe during the Battle of Hogwarts,
it mutates to form a gigantic pack of fiery beasts

spells.description: The Body-Bind Curse | Stiffens the target's limbs so they cannot move (except for their eyes)
spells.notable_uses: Hermione casts a full Body-Bind Curse on Neville when he confronts her, Harry and Ron as they sneak out of the Gryffindor Common Room at night

spells.description: The Animation Charm | Brings statues and suits of armour to life
spells.notable_uses: Professor McGonagall brings to life the statues and suits of armour throughout the school to defend it in the Battle of Hogwarts

spells.description: The Shield Charm | Conjures a protective shield around the caster (can have targeted effects as Protego Totalum, Protego Horribillis or Protego Diabolica)
spells.notable_uses: Gellart Grindelwald conjures a protective area of black flames which also attack his opponents

spells.description: The Quieting Charm | Quietens the target's voice (counter-charm to Sonorus)
spells.notable_uses: Ludo Bagman lowers his voice after commentating the Quidditch World Cup final

spells.description: The Reductor Curse | Blasts solid objects to pieces
spells.notable_uses: Hermione, Ron, Ginny, Neville and Luna fire this curse at the shelves holding the prophecies in the Department of Mysteries

spells.description: The Mending Charm | Repairs broken objects (for targeted effect, can add a special prefix - e.g. Oculus or Papyrus for glasses and paper, respectively)
spells.notable_uses: Hermione fixes Harry's glasses on the Hogwarts Express

spells.description: The Tickling Charm | Overcomes the target with a severe tickling sensation
spells.notable_uses: Malfoy sinks to his knees in laughter after Harry hits him with this Charm

spells.description: The Boggart-Banishing Charm | Forces a Boggart to assume a less-threatening, comical form. At the sound of laughter, the Boggart will burst into a thousand tiny wisps of smoke and disappear
spells.notable_uses: Professor Lupin teaches the class how to repel Boggarts in his first Defence Against the Dark Arts lesson

spells.description: The Hex-Repelling Charm | Protective enchantment against hexes
spells.notable_uses: Hermione casts protective enchantments around camp to shield against Death Eaters

spells.description: The Scouring Charm | Cleans the target
spells.notable_uses: Ginny cleans Neville and Luna of Stinksap

spells.description: The Silencing Charm | Renders the target temporarily mute
spells.notable_uses: Harry, Hermione and Ron practise this charm on frogs and ravens in a Charms lesson

spells.description: The Amplifying Charm | Magnifies Target's Voice
spells.notable_uses: Lugo Bagman magnifies his voice to commentate the Quidditch World Cup Final

spells.description: The Stunning Spell | Renders the target unconscious
spells.notable_uses: Harry stuns an “Imperiused” Krum to save Cedric Diggory

spells.description: Leaves the target with a feeling of great contentment
spells.notable_uses: In their third-year exams, Harry overdoes his Cheering Charm leaving Ron in fits of hysterical laughter

spells.description: Produces a powerful force of magic intended to weaken, but not kill, the target
spells.notable_uses: Albus Dumbledore uses this against Voldemort in their duel in the Atrium of the British Ministry of Magic

spells.description: Causes the target to have fiery, hot breath
spells.notable_uses: Mentioned as part of Basic Hexes for the Busy and Vexed

spells.description: Causes the target to fall into a deep, bewitched sleep
spells.notable_uses: Assuring they will be safe, Albus Dumbledore places the hostages of the second Triwizard Tournament Task into a deep sleep as they are placed in the Black Lake

spells.description: The Windy Spell | Shoots spiralling wind from the tip of the wand
spells.notable_uses: Newt Scamander uses this spell to get away from an Auror tracking him

spells.description: The Green Sparks Spell | Conjures a jet of green sparks from the tip of the caster’s wand
The Levitation Charm | Levitates objects a few feet in the air
spells.notable_uses: Ron levitates a troll’s club and drops it on its owners head, knocking the troll out
